description: This file contains extension methods for the IAsyncBatchObservable interface, providing convenient overloads for subscribing with delegate handlers in the Orleans streaming framework.

classes.name: AsyncBatchObservableExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for IAsyncBatchObservable to facilitate subscribing with delegate handlers.

methods.name: SubscribeAsync
methods.description: Overloaded extension methods that allow subscribing to an IAsyncBatchObservable instance using delegate handlers for OnNext, OnError, and OnCompleted events.
